706990101.text: Honorary Knight! We're so lucky to have you come and test out the entertainment stalls. It really puts my mind at ease!

706990102.text: This is actually my first time taking part in a development project, so I'm a little nervous. It's kinda frying my brain...

706990103.text: All I had to do was put a casing on an existing device. But there were so many design considerations, so many parameters to adjust...

706990104.text: I don't envy Captain Albedo, having to create purpose-built devices from scratch... It must be such a difficult task.

706990107.text: Wow, uh... Th—Thank you! Thanks, Honorary Knight, that means a lot coming from you!

706990108.text: I'll... I'll keep doing my best. Hopefully, I'll get to the point where I can build some useful stuff for the Reconnaissance Company...

706990109.text: Oh, I won a few toys in one of the games. I'd like you to have this one...

706990110.text: I have another one the same. Now, whenever I look at it, I'll think of all the encouragement you gave me!
